# Template: number_line
A number line: ticks and numerals from min to max, optional points (open/closed circles for strict/non-strict endpoints), shaded intervals (a thick overlay marking a solution range), and curved "hop" arrows for addition/subtraction. Choose this scene for ANY request about a number line, an inequality, an interval, a solution set on the real line, or showing addition/subtraction as a jump along a number line.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "min": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Left end of the line (default -5)."
  },
  "max": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Right end of the line (default 5)."
  },
  "step": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Spacing between tick numerals (default 1)."
  },
  "points": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "at": {
      "type": "number"
     },
     "label": {
      "type": "string"
     },
     "open": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Open (unfilled) circle for a strict inequality endpoint; filled (default) for non-strict / inclusion."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "at"
    ]
   }
  },
  "intervals": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "from": {
      "type": "number"
     },
     "to": {
      "type": "number"
     },
     "open_from": {
      "type": "boolean"
     },
     "open_to": {
      "type": "boolean"
     },
     "label": {
      "type": "string"
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "from",
     "to"
    ]
   },
   "description": "A shaded solution range, e.g. for an inequality."
  },
  "arrow_ops": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "from": {
      "type": "number"
     },
     "to": {
      "type": "number"
     },
     "label": {
      "type": "string"
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "from",
     "to"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Curved hop arrows, e.g. to show +3 or -2 as a jump."
  }
 },
 "additionalProperties": false
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- line: the number line itself
- tick_<v>: a tick mark + numeral at value v
- pt_<i>: marker for points[i], with its label when given
- interval_<i>: shaded overlay for intervals[i], with its label when given
- hop_<i>: curved hop arrow for arrow_ops[i], with its label when given
Examples:
Request: "Show the solution to x is greater than 1 on a number line." → params: {"points":[{"at":1,"label":"1","open":true}],"intervals":[{"from":1,"to":5,"open_from":true,"label":"x > 1"}]}

In YAML: `template: number_line` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
